name: dependency-observations.invalid.n06.confirmed-flag-strict-zero-one
basis: confirmed_by_human is a strict 0/1 flag (NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, CHECK (confirmed_by_human IN (0,1))): 0 = unconfirmed clue by default (never a suggestion on the read side), 1 = the explicit, recorded human-confirmation write. Anything else is refused.
